messages:
Sam Ortega: Heads up: when the model returns malformed JSON the console currently prints the raw parser error and stack. Users get scared.
Priya Desai: Ouch. We should never surface stacks. Need short, helpful copy + next steps (retry, sample output, or use "strict output" mode).
Miles Carter: Agreed. Recommendation: a concise title + a 1-line explanation + two CTAs: "Show raw output" and "Try again". Make "Show raw output" opt-in so we don't overwhelm non-technical users.
Sam Ortega: Draft microcopy: Title: "Couldn't parse model output" Body: "The model returned output we couldn't parse as structured data. You can inspect the raw response or try again with stricter output settings." Primary CTA: "Try again" Secondary: "Show raw response" (opens collapsible panel).
Priya Desai: Love it. Accessibility: if we show raw response it must be inside a <pre> with keyboard-focusable copy button and visible language label. Also add aria-live to the toast for screen readers.
Miles Carter: For power users include a one-line hint in the expandable: "Tip: set \"output_format\": \"json_schema\" to reduce parsing errors."
